'''2000 Brussels Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner was to receive a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 11 August 2000
* '''Site:''' De Kroon, Vandendrieschstraat 19, Sint-Agatha-Berchem, Belgium
* '''Held with:''' [[2000 European Championship]] weekend<ref name="gs00cal" />
* '''Tournament director:''' Joeri Hoste (listed contact)
* '''Winner:''' [[Martin Akesson]]<ref name="tr-d1133" />
